collections.name: Deep Ocean
collections.description: A collection brings together works connected by a marine sensibility rather than a single style. The pieces vary in form, scale, and material, but share a common relationship to water — its depth, movement, and quiet force.

collections.name: Golden
collections.description: Moments caught in warmth and light. These works explore moments when something ordinary shifts — when material, texture, or color begins to glow from within.

collections.name: Storms
collections.description: These works reflect what turbulence brings: tension, rupture, clarity, movement. This collection is about what storms reveal, and where they lead us once the air begins to settle.

collections.name: Of Ash and Flowers
collections.description: A meditation on renewal. Exploring burned textures and organic forms, holding space for both damage and persistence — for what remains after fire has passed.

collections.name: The Calm of the Forest
collections.description: Stillness and memory intertwined with nature's quiet wisdom. Each piece honors the forests that hold our stories.

collections.name: Following Her Steps
collections.description:
Following Her Steps is a collection about lineage — about the paths shaped by women before us, and the ways we move through the same world carrying their traces.

These works reflect different moments along that shared journey: pressure, resilience, interruption, moments of weakness, and endurance. Each piece holds a distinct state, staying exist within the same field, shaped by similar forces. The ground beneath the feet doesn't change, what changes is the way each woman learns to move across it.

This collection is my way of listening to womanhood, through memories of my mother and grandmother, and the stories our family has carried about the women before us.

 Created based on the photo by Sophie Russel - purple waves as an emotional background, I used coil pieces as a symbol of a place my roots from, air plant as a living being able to survive with no soil, purple maple leaves to to shine back and the splashes of all kind of movement we chose or we perform under pressure made by acrylic paint.
